items.summary: Despite its name, Change.org has developed a reputation as an ineffective platform. Many of its petitions promote so-called "slacktivism" rather than motivating activists to work toward justice in their communities. With new leadership in charge and new technology on board, Change.org is looking to turn over a new leaf.
